lessons: When a demo composes a shared fixture (e.g. _fixtures Card) inside an absolutely-positioned scene, direction:rtl must be set on the SCENE ROOT, not on individual chrome bars — the fixture inherits direction, and setting RTL on one bar while leaving the root LTR produces comps whose interiors disagree (the round-1 major finding).
